candidate_relations.reason: Intracranial atherosclerosis is an incompatible cause of this young-adult medullary infarct compared with neurosyphilis, and CTA/MRA were unremarkable.
MRI showed recent ischemic infarction without hemorrhagic transformation, so hemorrhagic stroke conflicts with both the imaging and neurosyphilis as the requested object.
RCVS is a different vasculopathy; vessels were normal and the presentation is a discrete medullary infarct, not thunderclap vasoconstriction.

case_quality_flags: No complete_equivalent candidate; the record describes a cryptogenic medullary infarct and does not include syphilis serology or CSF-VDRL.
